title: Python Setup and First Program
task: Create lesson01.py and print Rebootv2 Python setup works! Run it from the project folder.
verify: Exact message appears without traceback.
challenge: Change the message to introduce yourself.

title: Variables and Data Types
task: Create name, lessons_completed, completion_rate and is_learning using string, integer, float and Boolean values. Print each value and type.
verify: Types are str, int, float and bool; the name is printed separately.
challenge: Add project name, task count, hours and active flag.
risk: Expected output in source omits the printed name
asset: Type reference and complete expected output

title: Input Output and Basic Operators
task: Ask for name and practice hours. Convert hours to float, multiply by 60 and print the result.
verify: Taylor and 1.5 produce Taylor, you practiced for 90 minutes.
challenge: Calculate two numbers; explain what happens when the divisor is zero.

title: Conditionals
task: Read an integer score. Use if score >= 90, elif score >= 70, else to print Excellent, Passed or Keep practicing.
verify: 95, 75 and 60 select three different branches.
challenge: Test boundary scores 90, 70 and 69.

title: Loops
task: Enumerate collect data, process data and send report starting at 1. Then count down from 3 with a while loop.
verify: Three numbered tasks and 3, 2, 1, Go! appear; loop terminates.
challenge: Print five personalized mock processing messages.

title: Functions
task: Define calculate_total(price, quantity), return their product, and format calculate_total(19.99, 3) with two decimal places.
verify: Output is $59.97; assertions for (10,2) and (0,5) pass.
challenge: Return a trimmed full name from a two-argument function.

title: Lists Dictionaries and Collections
task: Create a customer dictionary with name, email and active. Print its email; iterate a list of validate, transform and send.
verify: Email and three task names print in sequence.
challenge: Filter a list of three customers to active entries only.
risk: Missing keys and list versus dictionary confusion

title: Strings and Data Cleaning
task: Apply strip().lower() to the string with spaces around USER@Example.COM.
verify: Result is user@example.com.
challenge: Normalize Alex.SMITH@EXAMPLE.com with surrounding spaces.
risk: Normalization incorrectly described as email validation

title: Files and Data Persistence
task: Write three task lines to tasks.txt using UTF-8, then reopen and read the file.
verify: Three lines survive a separate run; file is in the current working directory.
challenge: Append a fourth line without replacing the first three.
risk: Source says beside script but relative paths use working directory

title: Errors and Exception Handling
task: Convert input to int and divide 100 by it. Handle ValueError and ZeroDivisionError separately.
verify: 5 prints 20.0; hello requests a whole number; 0 reports zero divisor.
challenge: Add finally and explain when it runs.

title: Modules Packages and Virtual Environments
task: Create .venv, create helpers.py with greet(name), and import greet into lesson11.py.
verify: Running through the environment prints Hello, Rebootv2!
challenge: Import a second helper function.

title: Python Foundations Milestone
task: Normalize ALICE, BOB and carol example emails. Reject blank records, count accepted records and write them to a UTF-8 file.
verify: Three clean emails persist; blank input is rejected; count equals file line count.
challenge: Rebuild without copying the earlier solution.

title: Git Repository Foundations
task: Initialize a repository, add .gitignore for .venv, __pycache__, .env and *.pyc, inspect the staged diff and commit.
verify: git status is clean after commit; ignored secrets are absent from tracked files.
challenge: Explain one commit using git show.

title: Capstone Requirements and Architecture
task: Write a README covering problem, user, inputs, processing, outputs, failures and definition of done. Create src, tests and docs.
verify: Explain input to validation to processing to output before implementation.
challenge: Add a concrete rejection case and expected message.
risk: Source resource map assigns Git here instead

title: Capstone MVP Build
task: Create src/__init__.py and src/app.py. Implement normalize_record with trimmed name and lowercase trimmed email.
verify: Alex Smith and alex@example.com appear for padded mixed-case inputs.
challenge: Reject blank name or email with a clear error.
risk: Reported title mismatch and missing input checks

title: Testing QA and Refactoring
task: Test normalization, blank rejection and mixed case. Run test functions using a test runner or call them explicitly.
verify: Tests execute and pass; a deliberate wrong expected value fails.
challenge: Refactor once and rerun all tests.
risk: Defining a test function alone does not run it
asset: Test runner instructions and acceptance table

title: GitHub Portfolio and Capstone Handoff
task: Inspect staged files, push to the exact repository URL and write setup, usage, tests, limitations and example output in README.
verify: A clean checkout can reproduce the demonstration without secrets.
challenge: Review one issue, fix it and commit separately.
risk: Public code sharing before security review
asset: Portfolio rubric and code review prompt

title: Automation Architecture
task: Draw trigger, input, validation, AI or business logic, action, log and failure path for a request-routing workflow.
verify: Explain every transition and identify who owns each failure.
challenge: Replace one AI decision with deterministic validation.

title: Prompt Engineering
task: Classify a supplied request into sales, support, billing or other using explicit allowed labels.
verify: Duplicate-charge text maps to billing; vague text routes to review by policy.
challenge: Add three held-out messages and record actual outputs.
risk: Single example mistaken for reliable performance

title: System Instructions and Guardrails
task: Write instructions to use supplied facts, return a defined schema and route missing information to review. Enforce validation outside the model.
verify: Incomplete input produces a review state and no downstream action.
challenge: Test an input that asks the model to ignore the rules.
risk: Prompt-only security and inconsistent sentinel format

title: Structured AI Output and JSON
task: Validate category, priority, summary and needs_human fields with required keys, types and enums before routing.
verify: Malformed JSON, unknown category and string true are rejected.
challenge: Add a separate status field with ok or needs_review.
risk: Example object called a schema without constraints

title: API Fundamentals
task: Use a documented sandbox endpoint with timeout, status check and JSON parsing; install requests in the selected environment if used.
verify: Successful response parses; timeout and error response take defined failure paths.
challenge: Test a non-JSON response safely.
risk: Placeholder api.example.com is not a runnable endpoint

title: Webhooks
task: Receive a mock lead.created event, verify provider authentication where supported, validate fields and deduplicate event IDs.
verify: Valid event is processed once; missing email is rejected; replay causes no duplicate.
challenge: Test two deliveries of the same event.

title: Spreadsheet Data Automation
task: Map created_at, name, email, category and status into named columns in a test sheet.
verify: One accepted record lands in the correct columns; replay does not add a duplicate.
challenge: Reorder columns and verify named mapping remains correct.

title: Email Automation
task: Build a draft using validated name, email and category. Test only with your own address before enabling sending.
verify: Personalization is complete and recipient matches the test allowlist.
challenge: Reject a blank email and prevent duplicate sends.

title: Form Intake Automation
task: Collect name, email, request and consent where needed. Reject missing email, blank request or absent required consent.
verify: Four fixtures exercise success and each rejection path.
challenge: Record a human-readable reason for rejection.

title: File Document Automation
task: Validate file type and size, extract permitted content, treat embedded instructions as untrusted, then store approved output.
verify: An allowed text file processes; oversized or disallowed file is rejected.
challenge: Test extraction failure without losing original metadata.

title: Lead CRM Automation
task: Normalize email, search for an existing record, then update or create using an idempotency or uniqueness mechanism.
verify: Repeated input results in one record, including concurrent retries.
challenge: Preserve fields absent from the update request.
risk: Search then create alone is not concurrency safe

title: Research and Summarization Workflow
task: Summarize supplied material with finding, supporting evidence, open questions and source references.
verify: Missing facts are marked Not established; every claim has a supporting passage.
challenge: Provide contradictory sources and state the disagreement.

title: Content Workflow
task: Define idea, brief, draft, review, approval and publish states. Require explicit approval before publication.
verify: Draft, rejected and pending states cannot publish.
challenge: Invalidate approval when the draft changes.
risk: Boolean approval detached from draft version

title: Support FAQ Automation
task: Route supported questions to approved knowledge; send ambiguous or account-risk requests to human review.
verify: Unsupported answer is withheld; sensitive account action is not improvised.
challenge: Evaluate routing on labeled examples.
risk: Model confidence is not calibrated probability
asset: Escalation rubric and FAQ test set

title: Scheduling Calendar Automation
task: Validate title, start, end, IANA timezone and intended attendee using a test calendar.
verify: End follows start; displayed local time matches intent; no duplicate event.
challenge: Test daylight-saving ambiguity and conflict handling.
risk: Naive date strings and duplicate invitations

title: Database Workspace Automation
task: Find by stable ID; update only intended fields; create only on an explicit missing-record rule.
verify: Same name with different IDs remains separate; repeated update is safe.
challenge: Reject an update without a stable ID.
risk: Display name used as unique key

title: Branching Filters and Routers
task: Route high priority to urgent, otherwise sales to sales, otherwise standard.
verify: billing/high is urgent; sales/low is sales; support/low is standard.
challenge: Test sales/high to verify precedence.

title: Failure Handling and Retries
task: Classify transient, validation, authentication and rate-limit failures. Bound attempts and use provider retry guidance.
verify: Transient failure can recover; invalid data stops; exhausted retries alert.
challenge: Replay a failed send without duplicating side effects.

title: Human in the Loop Approval
task: Bind approval to an exact draft version, approver and expiration. Execute only approved unchanged drafts.
verify: Pending, rejected, edited and expired drafts do not execute.
challenge: Approve once and test repeated callback delivery.

title: Secrets Privacy and Security
task: Read an environment variable using os.getenv and stop if absent. Keep .env ignored; use an explicit loader only if chosen.
verify: Missing secret stops safely; logs and staged diff contain no secret.
challenge: Explain provider rotation after exposure.

title: Logging and Observability
task: Record run ID, timestamp, step, status, duration and a non-sensitive record reference.
verify: Trace success and failure without passwords, tokens or unnecessary personal data.
challenge: Correlate a retry with the original run.
risk: Source sample lacks timestamp and step

title: Automation Testing and Evaluation
task: Build held-out normal, empty, malformed, ambiguous and downstream-failure cases.
verify: Compare actual versus expected outcomes; route empty input to review status.
challenge: Repeat AI tests and record variability.

title: End to End Automation Capstone
task: Connect intake, validation, normalization, classification, routing, record update, draft, approval, send and logging.
verify: Seven cases pass: success, missing field, ambiguity, duplicate, rejection, downstream failure and final recovery.
challenge: Demonstrate restart without duplicate sends.

title: Portfolio Completion and Next Project
task: Assemble Python project, Git capstone, README, tests, automation diagram, demo, failure notes and security notes.
verify: Reviewer reproduces results and verifies evidence for all three milestones.
challenge: Choose one independent extension and document before and after.
next: Master playlist and verified advanced project
